title: AI Benefits Research Queue
scope: A selected queue of public reports and research sources describing concrete beneficial outcomes or protective interventions. Screened for relevance from existing summaries; underlying sources and AI attribution remain to be verified. These are research leads, not additional reviewed benefit records.

records.title: Watch alert followed by treatment for ventricular tachycardia
records.description: A high-heart-rate alert prompted hospital attendance; the reported care pathway included confirmation and successful ablation.
records.outcome: A high-heart-rate alert prompted hospital attendance; the reported care pathway included confirmation and successful ablation.
records.screening_rationale: A specific clinical episode links an alert to help-seeking and treatment.
records.verification_task: Check the watch feature’s AI role and distinguish its alert from the implanted defibrillator and clinical treatment.

records.title: Low-heart-rate alert followed by correction of medication-related bradycardia
records.description: A wearable alert prompted assessment; the suspected medication was stopped and heart rate normalized.
records.outcome: A wearable alert prompted assessment; the suspected medication was stopped and heart rate normalized.
records.screening_rationale: The imported case describes an observed improvement following care, rather than a detection benchmark.
records.verification_task: Verify the case report and whether the alert used AI or conventional threshold logic.
records.source_text: Andres Cordova Sanchez 2022, Journal of Investigative Medicine High Impact Case Reports · source

records.title: Wearable alert prompts care for atrial fibrillation
records.system: Smartwatch, brand not stated (repeated irregular-rhythm/AF notifications)
records.description: Alerts prompted emergency assessment and cardioversion in a reported atrial-fibrillation case.
records.outcome: Alerts prompted emergency assessment and cardioversion in a reported atrial-fibrillation case.
records.screening_rationale: A specific patient received diagnosis and treatment after an alert.
records.verification_task: Verify the outcome, the alert mechanism, and the distinction between device and clinician contributions.

records.title: Wearable alert leads to recognition and treatment of complete heart block
records.description: A low-heart-rate alarm prompted assessment; a pacemaker was implanted.
records.outcome: A low-heart-rate alarm prompted assessment; a pacemaker was implanted.
records.screening_rationale: The reported episode connects an alert with recognition of a serious condition and treatment.
records.verification_task: Verify AI attribution and the patient’s subsequent outcome in the primary case report.
records.source_text: Overbeek 2019, Am J Emerg Med · source

records.title: Nighttime heart-rate alerts prompt atrial-fibrillation treatment
records.description: Alerts led to recognition of atrial fibrillation and initiation of anticoagulation after an earlier transient ischemic attack.
records.outcome: Alerts led to recognition of atrial fibrillation and initiation of anticoagulation after an earlier transient ischemic attack.
records.screening_rationale: The reported benefit is recognition and treatment; no stroke-prevention claim is inferred.
records.verification_task: Verify the case and alert mechanism; do not equate treatment initiation with a demonstrated stroke avoided.
records.source_text: Weichert I 2019, Oxford Medical Case Reports · source

records.title: Wearable detection informs atrial-fibrillation care after stroke
records.system: Apple Watch (irregular rhythm notification + ECG app; self-purchased)
records.description: Atrial fibrillation was confirmed, treatment changed, and a planned loop recorder was reportedly avoided.
records.outcome: Atrial fibrillation was confirmed, treatment changed, and a planned loop recorder was reportedly avoided.
records.screening_rationale: The imported case identifies concrete changes in care.
records.verification_task: Verify the patient-level outcome and which part of detection was algorithmic or AI-assisted.
records.source_text: Patel 2021, Cardiovascular Digital Health Journal · source

records.title: Lunit chest X-ray case series
records.system: Lunit INSIGHT CXR case series (PLOS ONE 2023)
records.description: Published cases describe AI-flagged, incidental lung cancers found during routine practice.
records.outcome: Published cases describe AI-flagged, incidental lung cancers found during routine practice.
records.screening_rationale: A clinical case collection can supply specific diagnostic episodes with patient-level evidence.
records.verification_task: Review individual cases, intervention timing, outcomes, and possible overlap before promoting a case.

records.title: Drone-delivered defibrillator study
records.description: A study reports real-world defibrillator deliveries and a documented survivor following defibrillation.
records.outcome: A study reports real-world defibrillator deliveries and a documented survivor following defibrillation.
records.screening_rationale: The collection concerns actual emergency responses and a patient outcome.
records.verification_task: Verify the documented case and the drone system’s AI contribution; do not count deliveries as lives saved.

records.title: Google Big Sleep vulnerability reports
records.description: Public reports document particular software vulnerabilities discovered with AI assistance.
records.outcome: Public reports document particular software vulnerabilities discovered with AI assistance.
records.screening_rationale: Specific vulnerability reports provide identifiable protective interventions for follow-up.
records.verification_task: Verify CVE identifiers, disclosure and remediation, and the AI contribution in each episode.

records.title: DARPA AI Cyber Challenge results
records.description: Competition results describe real software vulnerabilities discovered and patches produced.
records.outcome: Competition results describe real software vulnerabilities discovered and patches produced.
records.screening_rationale: The reported outputs include concrete repairs, rather than only model scores or investment claims.
records.verification_task: Separate competition context, real-world patch adoption, and independently validated findings.

records.title: Skin-checking app prompts clinical assessment

records.outcome: A report describes a person seeking medical care after an app flagged a suspicious mole.
